headline: PASS: 10 of 10 checks pass at desktop and phone widths.
target: local server (python3 -m http.server) on this branch

checks.check: the title screen opens to the toy workshop, with nothing loaded from the internet
notes: desktop: 4 kinds, 8 colours twice, 4 patterns, 3 shapes, 4 extras; no requests outside the site; no sideways scrolling
phone: 4 kinds, 8 colours twice, 4 patterns, 3 shapes, 4 extras; no requests outside the site; no sideways scrolling

checks.check: picking parts changes the preview, locked parts cost sparkle coins, and the arrow keys and Enter work
notes: desktop: with 0 coins Glitter stayed locked; with 25 coins Glitter (15) and the Bunny shape (10) unlocked, leaving 0; clicked Glitter and Bunny, then Down, Right, Right, Enter picked Purple
phone: with 0 coins Glitter stayed locked; with 25 coins Glitter (15) and the Bunny shape (10) unlocked, leaving 0; tapped Glitter and Bunny

checks.check: the factory makes exactly the fidget that was designed, stage by stage, in about 13 seconds
notes: desktop: the show runs 13.2 s: cut at 2.7 s, paint at 5.4 s, stamp at 8.9 s, extras at 10.6 s; the toy that comes off the belt matches the design field for field, goes on the shelf and opens to play
phone: the show runs 13.2 s: cut at 2.7 s, paint at 5.4 s, stamp at 8.9 s, extras at 10.6 s; the toy that comes off the belt matches the design field for field, goes on the shelf and opens to play

checks.check: a flick spins the spinner, it slows down by itself, and the best spin time and coins are saved
notes: desktop: the drag flicked it at 44 rad/s; Space pushed it to 28, 3 s later it was at 19.4, and it stopped by itself after 21.2 s: best spin saved, 7 coins earned
phone: the drag flicked it at 62 rad/s; Space pushed it to 28, 3 s later it was at 19.4, and it stopped by itself after 21.2 s: best spin saved, 7 coins earned

checks.check: pop-it bubbles pop when tapped, Space pops the rest, and flipping it brings them all back with the colours swapped
notes: desktop: 25 bubbles: clicked 5, Space popped the other 20; Flip it! turned it over (side 2, pink and teal swapped), every bubble came back up and the full board paid 3 coins (2 from pops before)
phone: 25 bubbles: tapped 5, Space popped the other 20; Flip it! turned it over (side 2, pink and teal swapped), every bubble came back up and the full board paid 3 coins (2 from pops before)

checks.check: the squishy squashes and stretches under a finger and springs back when let go
notes: desktop: holding squashed it to 0.59 tall and 1.31 wide; dragging pulled the edge out 0.34; 2 s after letting go it was back to shape; Space squished it again
phone: holding squashed it to 0.59 tall and 1.31 wide; dragging pulled the edge out 0.50; 2 s after letting go it was back to shape; Space squished it again

checks.check: the clicky cube's button, switch and slider click, and the arrows turn it to the next face
notes: desktop: button: 1 click; the turn button and ArrowRight turned it to the switch (now on) and the slider; sliding end to end clicked every notch (13 clicks so far)
phone: button: 1 click; the turn button and ArrowRight turned it to the switch (now on) and the slider; sliding end to end clicked every notch (13 clicks so far)

checks.check: pause stops the clock, Start over resets the toy, and coins, unlocks, the shelf and best spin survive a reload
notes: desktop: pause held the toy still (clock at 0.15 s); Start over put all the bubbles back; after a reload: 33 coins, the same shelf and unlocks; save keys: gameon.fidget-factory.save
phone: pause held the toy still (clock at 0.08 s); Start over put all the bubbles back; after a reload: 33 coins, the same shelf and unlocks; save keys: gameon.fidget-factory.save

checks.check: the shelf holds 12 fidgets: a full shelf asks you to recycle one, and the game still plays when saving is blocked
notes: desktop: a seeded shelf of 12 shows 12 of 12; To the factory! sent us back to the shelf; ✕ then Recycle? removed one and a shelf fidget opened to play; with storage blocked a new spinner still built and spun

phone: a seeded shelf of 12 shows 12 of 12; To the factory! sent us back to the shelf; ✕ then Recycle? removed one and a shelf fidget opened to play; with storage blocked a new spinner still built and spun

checks.check: Fidget Factory has a card right after the Editor's Choice games and plays in its frame
notes: desktop: card at position 2, after the 1 Editor's Choice card(s) and ahead of ant-farm-wars, with its 800x450 cover and "Made by Kiki"; inside the frame it went workshop, factory (skipped), play
